description: The Freshwater Health Index toolbox calculates social and ecological indicators for freshwater basins. Sustainable Software Solutions developed the C# application for Conservation International, which supplies the MIT licence. The paper describes a shared basin database, indicator algorithms and geospatial processing. Repository files include connectivity indicators, dam-related controls and ecosystem-service assessment components. Geographic coverage and reference periods follow the chosen basin and supplied observations; indicator summaries are not a fixed-resolution hydrodynamic simulation. The public code is free and can support preparation of basin condition and management inputs for water-infrastructure scenario studies. It complements flow and allocation models with ecological and institutional context. A limitation is that the provider download webpage was unavailable during this check, while the repository remains readable. The brief README gives little deployment detail, so current desktop compatibility and input-data completeness remain untested. No installer, basin dataset or indicator calculation was downloaded or executed.
